source_excerpts.text:
F. RESEARCH STATUS AND EQUAL-INFORMATION ALTERNATIVES
Hierarchical iterative exponential growth is PRIOR ART, including Clapperton/Hood/Tran Chem Sci 2025 doi:10.1039/D5SC01296A and protecting-group-free multi-click IEG 2021 doi:10.1021/acsmacrolett.0c00812. Do not claim the basic balanced assembly tree is novel. Niu/Hili/Liu 2013 demonstrated templated non-nucleic-acid 16-block translation, not the integrated bond-qualified, salvageable 1023-mer device. Cabello-Garcia et al., Nat Chem 2025 doi:10.1038/s41557-025-01831-x, demonstrated a recyclable template for DNA dimerization, and embedding into a covalent-formation reaction; not an autonomously fully covalent long-polymer constructor.

A serious competing route is protecting-group-free IEG using orthogonal chemistries. Its advantage is an actual demonstrated soluble oligomer chemistry; the suggested DNA-programmed checkpoint's only conditional advantage is independent programmes and recovery of verified fragments. A positive bond-path capture will not measure wrong-site specificity, ring closure, selection purity or steric accessibility; all require separate controls. Final product identity needs direct junction-sensitive analytics such as MS/MS, not only DNA identifiers or total mass. DNA-cleavable handles must be retained through checkpointing then removed under cargo-compatible conditions.

NEXT PHYSICAL DISCRIMINATOR
Use two distinguishable A-ended fragments and a B connector, with one deliberately unreactive/missed junction, to compare (i) unmasked ternary bridge, (ii) selectively capped outer A ends, (iii) separately docked single-end orthogonal couplings / conventional IEG. Assay true correct A-B-A covalent orientation, intrafragment rings, wrong orientation, persistent active terminals, root recovery and mass balance. Measure selectivity alpha/eta and how it changes after first click on fragment sizes 1,3,7,15. Reject claims of safe long-fragment joining absent compatible protection and measurement.

/mnt/data/astra_chemistry_odd_bridge.py -- symbolic alternating-port parity, all six endpoint outcomes, selection-rate requirements and odd-fragment resource recurrence.
